title: ChatGPT for Word 上线，OpenAI 员工称 Excel 和 PowerPoint 用量近期激增
content:
正文 · AI 翻译
ChatGPT for Word 来了！！直接在 Microsoft Word 中调用 ChatGPT / Codex 的强大能力。
ChatGPT for Excel 和 Powerpoint 的使用量最近呈爆炸式增长--很高兴终于把它带到 Word，补齐这一环！
拖延症终于遇到对手了。ChatGPT 现已登陆 Word。 你可以将 ChatGPT 添加到 Microsoft Word，把粗略笔记变成初稿、理清棘手的段落、校对，并获得修改建议--全程无需离开你的文档。 它甚至能发现格式问题。这意味着之后要修的东西又少了几样 🔍

report.summary: OpenAI launches ChatGPT for Word, completing its Microsoft Office integration after surging usage of its Excel and PowerPoint versions.
report.background: OpenAI and Microsoft have partnered for years, but Microsoft 365 Copilot has been the primary AI layer inside Word, Excel, and PowerPoint. OpenAI's own ChatGPT add-ins offer a vendor-neutral alternative that works directly inside documents. The Excel and PowerPoint versions reportedly saw explosive adoption, showing strong demand for AI that lives in the productivity tools people already use. Word was the missing piece, and its launch completes a natural trio for knowledge workers. The timing also reflects intensifying competition in enterprise AI: Google bundles Gemini into Workspace, Microsoft pushes Copilot, and OpenAI wants its own brand present where documents are written, edited, and reviewed. Mention of Codex suggests agentic coding and automation capabilities may extend beyond chat into document workflows.
key_points: ChatGPT for Word plugs directly into Microsoft Word, letting users turn rough notes into drafts, untangle difficult paragraphs, proofread, get revision suggestions, and catch formatting issues without leaving the document.

The launch completes OpenAI's Office suite coverage: Word, Excel, and PowerPoint. An OpenAI employee said ChatGPT for Excel and PowerPoint usage recently exploded, indicating strong real-world demand.
It positions OpenAI's ChatGPT as both a complement and a competitor to Microsoft 365 Copilot, giving users a choice of AI assistant inside the same Office applications.
The mention of Codex hints that deeper automation, such as generating structured content or code-like logic, may be part of the Word integration rather than only text editing.
For end users, the main benefit is reduced context switching: drafting, editing, and reviewing happen in one place instead of copying text into a separate chat window.
report.impact: For the AI industry, this cements Office documents as a key battleground for assistant distribution, pushing Microsoft, Google, and OpenAI to compete on in-app intelligence rather than standalone chatbots. For developers, it signals growing demand for add-ins, plugins, and APIs that connect models to productivity workflows, and Codex's inclusion hints at agentic document automation. For regular users, AI writing help becomes more accessible but also raises questions about accuracy, data privacy, and overdependence on generated text. Organizations may need clearer policies on when AI-edited content is acceptable. Overall, the move normalizes AI as a standard feature of everyday work tools.
report.tools: Watch ChatGPT for Word, ChatGPT for Excel, and ChatGPT for PowerPoint add-ins, plus Microsoft 365 Copilot as the main incumbent. Developers can explore Office Add-ins APIs, OpenAI's API, and Codex-style agent frameworks. Alternatives include Google Gemini in Workspace, Notion AI, Cursor for code-adjacent writing, and open-source options like LibreOffice with LLM plugins. For drafting workflows, combine ChatGPT with Grammarly or LanguageTool for grammar checks.
